_comment: BOTH languages derive from this file at compile time, so the config can never silently drift: Rust reads it in `src-tauri/build.rs` (which re-emits environment variables for `src-tauri/src/lib.rs` to read via `env!`), and TS reads it in `vite.config.ts` (which injects values in `src/main.tsx`). Change the values here and rebuild — both sides follow.
_local_granted_scopes_comment: The host's granted scopes: gatekeeper seeds the `wildflower-host` client's allowed_scopes and mints the host owner token from this (Rust), and the WebView requests exactly this set at device-login (TS, NeedsAuthMessage). MUST cover gatekeeper-rust's WILDFLOWER_WIDEST_SCOPES (`system/*.cruds` + `wildflower/*.cruds`) or the Owner UI loses `/access/*` — gatekeeper asserts this at boot.
